ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white/light-gray pixels dominate approximately 75% of the visible surface, with low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the lateral edges, trailing tips, and the peri-notch region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes exhibit a solid light-gray intensity. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous boundary along the outer lateral edges and tapers into a wide V-shaped zone around the median notch. Fine-scale high-contrast white mottling is localized within the black pigmentation zone adjacent to the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A sharp V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel-calculated interior angle of 35-40 degrees, characterized by high depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations with pixel amplitudes varying between 2-8 pixels along the entire horizontal boundary; distinct jagged peaks are visible on the upper-right trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves tapering toward pointed, slightly upward-curling distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-intensity white pixel points (stippling) are concentrated in the dark pigmentation zone surrounding the median notch and scattered sparsely across the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the right lobe, with the longest measuring approximately 15% of the lobe's vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple vertical and diagonal linear rake marks on the right lobe; irregular edge erosion on the far right distal tip.
